title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 20: You Ain't Done

scenes.say: A morning show. From the battlefield to bestselling author. What would you tell the youth?
scenes.visual: a television studio couch under bright lights, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Pain ain't permanent. But neither is peace. You gotta fight for both.
scenes.visual: a guest speaking on a talk show, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: A prison classroom. Ali speaks to a room of inmates.
scenes.visual: inmates in a classroom seen from the back, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: I had a record. I had nothing. But I used my pain as power.
scenes.visual: a man speaking at the front of a stark classroom, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: One prisoner wipes a tear. You ain't done, unless you say you are.
scenes.visual: a hand wiping a face in a prison classroom, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: A candlelight vigil. Mothers of lost sons. Pictures on posters.
scenes.visual: candles flickering at a night vigil, photos on posters, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Thank you for remembering our boys. They ain't forgotten. Not while I breathe.
scenes.visual: a candle being lit from another candle, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He lights his candle and bows his head.
scenes.visual: a man bowing his head holding a candle, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Twenty One. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: many candles glowing in the dark, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 20 of 25: You Ain't Done. From the screenplay by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
